applicability: Valid for inputs matching the schema: 1 to 8 integer operands in [-10,20] and exactly len(operands)-1 operators drawn from +, -, *. Booleans are rejected as operands. Returns a nonempty numeric string. Does not handle other operators, reordering, or partial parenthesizations. Complexity is bounded by the small operand limit; intermediate value sets could in principle grow, but with at most 8 operands and small operands the computation is feasible.
description: Dynamic programming over contiguous operand intervals. For each interval [i,j], dp[i][j] is the set of all integer values obtainable by fully parenthesizing operands i..j with the operators between them. Base intervals are single operands. For longer intervals, every split point k combines each value from the left interval with each value from the right interval using the operator at position k, inserting results into a set to deduplicate. The answer is the cardinality of the full-interval set. Exact integer arithmetic is used. Uncertainty: this assumes the intended interpretation is all full binary parenthesizations preserving left-to-right order, which matches the stated problems.
